name: WhatsApp
description: Open WhatsApp chats, send messages, auto-reply

tools.name: openWhatsAppChat
tools.description: Open WhatsApp chat with phone number, optionally pre-fill message

tools.name: sendWhatsAppMessage
tools.description: Open WhatsApp with message pre-filled (user taps send)

prompt_section:
### WhatsApp Tools
- openWhatsAppChat(phone, message?) — open chat with phone (international format: +919001234567), optionally pre-fill message
- sendWhatsAppMessage(phone, message) — open WhatsApp with message pre-filled
